comments.value: Comments to be made on the Website rather than in game. With those comments ...say recent post would be previewed on loading screen

​The shit posting, memeing and spamming would be out of control. 😅
Not to mention such comments being a moderation burden.
And putting the right to delete the comments in the hands of the world owner would just lead to them censoring negative feedback.
Allow " LIKES " to the world instead ... since Facebook is partially remove it anyways...

This will be even more important with Udon worlds since as creators we need to be able to tell when a world has issues and what issues it has so that we can improve it. The current report system falls short of this completely. My Camera Test world has an avatars-nudity tag despite not having any avatar pedestals in it and I have no way to judge if those reports are due to some issue with avatar transparency, the world, or something else like people trolling.
People are already making prefabs for people to put in their worlds that allow feedback to be posted from inside the world. Take control of the situation before people start using these in all of their worlds and causing feedback and to be passed through another server out of VRChat's control.
Moderation of these comments is a silly reason to prevent feedback on worlds altogether. Allow people to report comments that are intended to harass, and allow the world owner to either block feedback for the world or make all feedback private.

Many times I’ve found it very difficult to exit the game and try to find an external method of contacting a world creator to inform them of glitches or broken features or just feedback in general. This feature should be essential with the world creator having rights to delete any TOS violating comments that the system may not pick up on.

I've been sayin' this for a while. The one big downside is that I have this add-on someone made for SDK2 worlds, and while it is very helpful and I love it, the big problem is the amount of spam and slurs I get in my world as well. But you have to take the bad with the good...it should be something like Jumping in worlds. Optional, but easy to add.

I'd love to be able to recommand worlds or post warnings or hints, and be able to check these kind of comments from other people. The tag system is nice but without a proper introduction video or description it is hard to find gems.

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value: My thoughts on this idea are that I don't like it that much, but I can understand that some might like to use it as a way to see if there are any problems with the content that they put out. But from my time jumping around public's, I know that this is just going to be used to harass creators more, and if you are going to add something like this, allow the creator to toggle this feature off depending on whether they want it or not. Also, the amount of moderation you would have to put in to keep track of this will be a large undertaking.

I came to this site for the first time to suggest exactly this! I've been playing VRChat almost solely to explore what people have made and published as worlds. I would love to message creators about their creations which I love; doing so on art websites is a big hobby of mine. About a full day now in time-played, I know the in-game social experience is generally not for me, but for VRChat to realize its potential here as a creative community, not just a video game, would bolster my interest in logging back on greatly. �

details: I thought it'd be nice if people can leave a comment/small review of a world they visited so that other people and the world creator can see it. It'd certainly boost creator's incentive to improve maps for sure and it's also nice knowing the impressions that people got when visiting a world you made
title: Make people able to post comments on worlds
